cv: MinimumNaNSplit, same 30 seeds for observed and each relabeling, re-stratified using that draw's labels

permutation_scope: same global draw for train/test, all repeats and all time windows
convergence: every observed and permuted fit must finish below max_iter with finite coefficients; no failed draw is discarded
SE: SE across CV-repeat means; split variability only
